newsitem.title: USA: Buba's Schieber-Not worried by present German CPI.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Schieber-Not worried by present German CPI.

text.p: Bundesbank directorate member Helmut Schieber said on Tuesday that the Bundesbank was currently not worried by the German price climate.
"We think at the moment the press climate does not worry us," Schieber told reporters before a round table discussion on the financial and monetary affairs sponsored by the European Institute.
In April, West German preliminary Consumer Price Index (CPI) measured 1.4 percent, which is below the Bundesbank's long-held medium-term inflation target of 2.0 percent.
Schieber however said that Germany would need to keep a watchful eye on currency market moves.

Germany's export driven economy is particularly sensitive to foreign exchange fluctuations and independent economists have expressed concerns that Germany may soon import inflation through a higher dollar level.
